metadata.description: Aura UI: Lovable-style UI skill for coding agents

plugins.name: aura-ui
plugins.description: Component UI manager for coding agents: keeps a registry of the project's own components, tokens and conventions in .aura/, answers 'what should I use' (aura find/show/tokens), and checks every component edit through agent hooks (duplicates, raw primitives, undefined tokens, foreign UI libraries). Also builds new apps Lovable-style from a shadcn starter.
